title: emergency.py: Missing type validation on ts/timeout_s enables crash-based DoS
description: Lines 217-218: POST accepts ts and timeout_s from user input without type validation. Sending {"id":"x", "ts":"bad"} stores started="bad". Subsequent _prune_expired() calls crash with TypeError on line 167 (int - str), permanently breaking the resource with 500 errors.
close_reason: Fixed in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py: render_post validates ts and timeout_s types (must be int/float, bool rejected, floats must be finite via math.isfinite; None rejected) plus ts >= 0. Malformed values get 4.00 Bad Request and are never stored, so _prune_expired's now - started arithmetic can no longer hit TypeError. Verified directly: {ts:'bad'}, ts=None, timeout_s=None all rejected, _prune_expired runs clean, resource remains functional.
